title: ESO Guideline 2024: Cerebral Small Vessel Disease, Part 2 — Lacunar Ischaemic Stroke

recommendations.text: A quarter of ischaemic strokes are lacunar subtype, typically neurologically mild and usually resulting from intrinsic cerebral small vessel pathology, with risk-factor profiles and outcome rates differing from other stroke subtypes. This guideline provides evidence-based recommendations for management of lacunar ischaemic stroke.
